seven_slots.objects_spaces: E,F finite-dimensional real inner-product spaces with intrinsic NormedAddCommGroup; f:F->EReal; actual continuous real-linear A:E->F, b:F,x:E. Completeness for actual adjoint is derived from both finite dimensions, not an extra premise. Euclidean matrix/transpose source included, no separately certified coordinate-isometry/functor.
seven_slots.quantifiers: Universally E,F and their structures; f, hp:SourceProper f, then arbitrary A,b,x. Every q in the entire adjoint image has a source witness g supporting f at Ax+b for ALL ambient points of F; conclusion tests ALL y:E. Proper finite witness is not required to lie in affine range.
seven_slots.assumptions: Only SourceProper f beyond displayed space/map types. No convexity, closedness, differentiability, Lipschitz, rank/injectivity/surjectivity, nonzero map/shift, positive dimension, proper composite, finite query or support-existence premise.
seven_slots.conclusion: A.adjoint image of SourceSubdifferential f (Ax+b) is SUBSET SourceSubdifferential (y->f(Ay+b)) x. Full image inclusion, not equality/converse or merely one selected witness.
seven_slots.constants_normalization: No bounds/rates/probability constants. Translation b cancels exactly; inner product coefficient one; transpose replaced by actual adjoint with no factor.
seven_slots.information_probability: Deterministic all-point support transport. No online data, feedback, optimization, computable/measurable selection, probability or regret conclusion.
seven_slots.boundaries: Zero/rank-deficient A and zero dimensions allowed. Proper f may be nonconvex and have empty supports. If f(Ax+b)=top, its finite witness rules out any global support, so left image empty. Generic support of identically-top composite is ALL E (top+finite=top); the printed proper-only subdifferential convention does not directly define this improper h, so explicit extension convention is essential. No hidden restriction to finite query.

SourceSubdifferential.body:
def SourceSubdifferential (f : E → EReal) (x : E) : Set E :=
  {g | ∀ y, f x + (inner ℝ g (y - x) : EReal) ≤ f y}

SourceProper.body:
def SourceProper (f : E → EReal) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, f x ≠ ⊥) ∧ ∃ x, ∃ r : ℝ, f x = (r : EReal)

effectiveDomain.body: def effectiveDomain (f : E → EReal) : Set E := {x | f x < ⊤}

realEpigraph.body: def realEpigraph (f : E → EReal) : Set (E × ℝ) := {p | f p.1 ≤ (p.2 : EReal)}

IsConvexExtended.body: def IsConvexExtended (f : E → EReal) : Prop := Convex ℝ (realEpigraph f)
